name: Soft Render
concept: Borderless pale fills and oversized light numerals, presented as a soft-focus 3D render in a grey studio.

type.families: Geometric sans, light to regular weight only (Aeonik, General Sans, Inter Light). This style never uses bold.
type.hierarchy: Numeral 56/56 light · title 20/26 regular · body 14/21 regular · label 11/14 regular in `--muted`. Weight contrast is deliberately low; size does the separating.
type.usage: Set everything a weight lighter than feels safe. Numerals are large and thin. No uppercase except tiny labels. Tracking stays neutral.

tokens.texture: Borderless fills — cards have no stroke at all, only a subtle fill difference from the ground, plus optional `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)` on translucent controls. The whole composition is presented as a soft-focus 3D render: a matte screen or device sitting in a grey studio with gentle depth-of-field falloff at the frame edges. Shadows are large and very soft (`0 40px 80px -40px rgb(0 0 0 / .35)`).
tokens.layout: Calm, wide and airy. 8px scale, 24px padding, 16-20px radius on every surface, controls fully rounded. Because there are no borders, spacing is the only separator — use 20-24px gaps, never 8px. Content sits in wide low cards rather than tall dense ones.

best_for: anything wanting a calm physical presence

image_recipe.template:
[SUBJECT: describe the subject in one clause — e.g. "a stack of shipping containers", "a single ceramic cup", "an abstract network of nodes"]

Rendered as soft-focus 3D product render, studio lighting.

STYLE — apply all of the following, they are not optional:
- matte grey studio environment #E2E2E2 with soft gradient falloff
- shallow depth of field — subject sharp, background falling gently out of focus
- one pale lime accent #DCEE92 on a small element only
- soft diffused key light from upper left, no hard shadows
- rounded matte geometry, no sharp edges

NEGATIVE SPACE: The defocused background should occupy at least a third of the frame.

DO NOT INCLUDE: hard specular highlights, saturated colour, busy environments, sharp corners, flat vector look, text in the image.

image_recipe.model: configurable — set to your image model
image_recipe.resolution: 1536x1024 (3:2 landscape); use 1024x1536 for portrait, 1024x1024 for square

shallow depth of field — subject sharp, background falling gently out of focus
